plain: A person who kidnaps people in order to sell them as slaves.

webster.text: One who steals and sells men.

example.quote: Let us figure to ourselves a company of these manstealers, well equipped for the enterprise, arriving on our coast.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New Hampshire Convention, Hon. JOSHUA ATHERTON, 1788 (undated fragment printed by Elliot) (2d ed. 1836)
